HERO: on '1939' (0.83) a giant '1939' Inter Tight 900 ~230 RED lands on a .paper-strip low on his chest / below the card as a SPLIT-FLAP (each digit squash-flips and locks left→right, ticks). MICRO 1: on 'student' (1.33) a little black-marker stick-figure student with a backpack runs in from the left edge along the card bottom (legs cycling on fours). MICRO 2: a black-marker CLOCK doodle (~170 px) beside the card top-right: on 'late' (1.87) its hands spin past the hour and it jiggles; a red underline scribbles under 'late' as 'late' (~120 ink) lands beside 1939. MICRO 3: 'class' (~110 ink) lands on 2.31. Keep the text hook untouched and readable; nothing over his face. Impact on '1939'.

Everything inside x 60–960 / y 285–1480 (measure). data-face 0.41 (navy hoodie = dark: words over it on a solid .paper-strip). Write beats.json (kit beats + scribble beats with dur).
